note: #979: feint doctor prints no OVN command on Debian 12, whose OVN 23.03.1 and Open vSwitch 3.1.0 are below the 24.03.0 and 3.3.0 Incus 7.4 and later require, and the mode line names stateless rules, with one plain line in a bridge mode saying such a group is refused. One mutation per question; each case of doctor_runtime979_test.go passes every other question and fails only its own. Mutations 1 to 6 hold the table of releases whose own OVN is too old (Debian 12 and, since the first correction cycle, Ubuntu 22.04), one clause each. Mutations 15 to 28 are the second pass of the lot: an installed OVN and Open vSwitch judged by version against machine.OVNMinimum and machine.OVSMinimum on every distribution, and the warning that the installed Incus is not machine.IncusTested. NOT HERE: the line as printed by checkRuntime, which builds the real Incus driver and has no seam; capabilityLines is what it calls.
